answer.summary: The API Types Check fails because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. The change adds the LocalObjectOutput DTO, but the developer did not regenerate the types before committing. Re-running gives the same diff, so fix it by running yarn generate-types-from-api and committing the result.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
